biotools.summary: QCatch is a command-line tool written in Python that generates comprehensive, interactive HTML QC reports specifically designed for single-cell quantification results, particularly those from alevin-fry or simpleaf. It streamlines the QC workflow by exporting processed results in H5AD format, a widely used format in single-cell analysis.
